name: ics-calendar-builder
description: Turn an event spreadsheet into a calendar file that Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook and phones can import. Pick the sheet with titles, dates and times, and get a standard .ics with time zones done properly (daylight saving included), all-day and multi-day events, reminders like 15 minutes or 1 day before, and repeats such as every week, every other week, Mon/Wed/Fri, workdays, monthly or yearly with a count or end date. Also get one .ics per event to send around and a printable schedule. Runs locally; no calendar account or API keys.

Also get one .ics per event to send around and a printable schedule. Runs locally; no calendar account or API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把活动表格变成 Apple 日历、Google 日历、Outlook 和手机都能导入的日历文件。选上写有标题、日期和时间的表格，就能得到标准的 .ics 文件：时区处理正确（包括夏令时），支持全天和跨多天的活动、提前 15 分钟或 1 天等提醒，以及每周、每两周、每周一三五、工作日、每月、每年等重复规则，可设次数或截止日期。还能给每个活动单独导出 .ics 方便转发，并生成可打印的日程表。在本地运行，不用登录日历账号，无需 API 密钥。
